rag.text:
Test: TC-4990 — Feature area - Exporting - Preserving template configuration - Cloud
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /
Labels: team#Enigma, teamembers

Steps:
1. Navigate to BigTemplate Configuration -> Templates
   Expected: A list of all available templates is displayed
2. Delete all templates.
   Expected: All templates are deleted.
3. Click on Upload template button and create a template passing the following set of data
   Data: moduleVisibility: Widget
templateName: New Widget Template
fileToUpload: TC4990.xlsx
setAsGlobalTemplate: unchecked
   Expected: Template is created and is visible on the templates list
4. Click on Upload template button and create a template passing the following set of data
   Data: moduleVisibility: Gantt
templateName: New Gantt Template
fileToUpload: TC4990.xlsx
setAsGlobalTemplate: unchecked
   Expected: Template is created and is visible on the templates list
5. Navigate to Manage add-ons page and Uninstall BigTemplate plugin
   Expected: BigTemplate is successfully uninstalled
6. Install BigTemplate plugin
   Expected: BigTemplate is successfully installed
7. Navigate to BigTemplate Configuration -> Templates
   Expected: Templates removed in step 2 are not visible.

Template added in step 3 is visible:

* New Widget Template

Template added in step 4 is visible:

* New Gantt Template
